newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks end at year-low as rupiah plunges.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks end at year-low as rupiah plunges.

text.p: Jakarta stocks suffered their steepest plunge ever to close at a year-low on Friday as investors panicked after the rupiah fell to another historic low, brokers said.

The composite index fell 25.31 points, or 3.94 percent, to close at 617.71 points. The index had fallen over four percent earlier in the day. Decliners led gainers by 147 to 11 with 29 issues unchanged.
Fifty-eight stocks, out of the around 250 listed, also touched year-lows. Total turn-over was estimated at 538 billion rupiah.
